name: kaisyuan-tseng/inquiry-form-inbox
description: Headless-friendly inquiry inbox for WordPress: archives every inquiry, tracks contacted state, and sends notifications.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run WordPress Coding Standards over the plugin source.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the violations phpcbf can handle.
scripts-descriptions.pot: Regenerate the translation template from source.
scripts-descriptions.test:static: Syntax, coding standards, string keys, gettext chain and readme compliance.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Pure-function tests, no WordPress and no database.
scripts-descriptions.test:int: Integration tests against a scratch wptests_ prefix; needs IFI_ALLOW_TEST_WRITES=1.
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: HTTP tests against a real PHP server on 127.0.0.1:8099; needs IFI_ALLOW_TEST_WRITES=1.
scripts-descriptions.test:ui: Render the admin screens in Chromium; needs IFI_ALLOW_TEST_WRITES=1.
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Every layer, cheapest first. Use this one before shipping.
scripts-descriptions.test: Static gates plus unit tests (the default local gate).
